- HyDE: Hypothetical Document Embeddings

핵심 내용
- Zero-shot retrieval 성능 향상을 위해 제안
- 주어진 query에 대한 relevant passage를 생성 모델로 생성
- 생성된 passage를 기반으로 collection에 검색
- Query-passage 검색에 비하여 유의미 함
- 단지 생성에 필요한 시간

섹션: Retrievals

모델 및 그림 설명
- Figure 1: An illustration of the HyDE model. Documents snippets are shown. HyDE serves all types of queries without changing the underlying GPT-3 and Contriever/mContriever models.
- 구성 요소: HyDE, GPT, Contriever
- 예시
  - instruction: write a passage to answer the question
    - query: how long does it take to remove wisdom tooth
    - generated document: It usually takes between 30 minutes and two hours to remove a wisdom tooth...
    - real document: How wisdom teeth are removed... Some ... a few minutes, whereas others can take 20 minutes or longer....
  - instruction: write a scientific paper passage to answer the question
    - query: How has the COVID-19 pandemic impacted mental health?
    - generated document: ...depression and anxiety had increased by 20% since the start of the pandemic...
    - real document: ... two studies investigating COVID-19 patients ... significantly higher level of depressive ...
  - instruction: write a passage in Korean to answer the question in detail
    - query: 인간은 언제 불을 사용했는가?
    - generated document: 인간이 불을 사용한 기록은 약 800만 년 전부터 나타난다...
    - real document: ... 불을 처음 사용한 시기는 호모 에렉투스가 살았던 142만 년 전으로 거슬러간다...
- 범례: instruction / query / generated document / real document

Retrievals

Generative Retrieval
- 기존 retriever의 한계
  - Inverted Index 방식의 한계
    - Exact term matching에 의존하므로 semantic matching이 어려움
    - Query와 document가 동일한 term을 포함하지 않으면 retrieval 불가
  - Dense Retrieval 방식의 한계
    - Document를 single embedding vector로 표현하는 데에는 한계가 있음
    - Document의 모든 semantic information을 함축하기 어려움
    - Query와 document 사이의 interaction을 모델링하기 어려움
    - Representation은 Query와 독립적으로 미리 계산되므로
    - Retrieval 시에는 cosine similarity 등 간단한 함수만 사용
  - Retrieval 최적화의 어려움
    - Index는 retrieval target과 독립적으로 구축됨
    - Target metric에 맞게 직접 최적화하는 것이 불가능
  - System 관점에서의 비효율성
    - Retrieval 이후에 별도의 ranking model이 필요함
    - Index 구축과 retrieval, ranking이 독립적으로 이뤄지므로 비효율적
    - 전체 pipeline을 end-to-end로 최적화하는 것이 어려움

Retrievals – Embeddings and ranking – RAG

Advanced RAG
- SuRE framework
1. Query와 관련된 passages 검색
2. LLM을 이용하여 answer candidates 생성
3. 각 candidate 별로 요약 생성
   - 이를 통해 LLM이 더 근거 있는 답변 유도
4. Prompting으로 요약 verification 수행
   - Q;C;P -> True or False
5. Prompting으로 pair-wise ranking 수행
6. 최종 answer 선택

예시 흐름
- Query: The concept of micro financing was developed by who in 1976?
- Retrieved Passages
  - Title: Innovative financing, Text: Innovative financing Innovative financing refers to … first mentioned and introduced at the International Conference on Financing for Development in 2002.
  - Title: ACORN International, Text: interns and volunteers that have come from George Brown College (Toronto), Carleton University … micro-finance since it has failed to reduce poverty.
- 1. Answer Candidates Generation
  - Candidates: (a) Muhammad Yunus, (b) Grameen Bank
- 2. Conditional Summarization
  - Summarization for (a): Microfinance is a term used to describe financial services… In 1976, Muhammad Yunus, a Bangladeshi economist, began experimenting… Therefore, it can be concluded that the concept of micro financing was developed by Muhammad Yunus in 1976.
  - Summarization for (b): … Grameen Bank is one of the pioneers of microfinance, having been founded in Bangladesh in 1983 by Muhammad Yunus. … the concept of micro financing was not developed by Muhammad Yunus in 1976, but rather by the Grameen Bank in 1983.
- 3. Verification
  - Validity of Summarization for (a): True, Validity of Summarization for (b): False, Relative informativeness: (a) > (b)
- Prediction
  - Therefore, the answer is "Muhammad Yunus"
